hunks.baseline: “They’re such vile bastards that even chewing them to pieces wouldn’t satisfy me! Don’t hold back!”
hunks.sol: “They’re vile bastards we could chew to pieces and still not be satisfied! Show no mercy!”

hunks.baseline: “The Lord of Heaven desires it! Destroy the Tang Clan!”
hunks.sol: “The Lord of Heaven wills it! Destroy the Tang Clan!”

hunks.baseline: Sword clashed against sword. Harsh breathing mixed with ragged cries. The killing intent and scent of blood given off by several hundred people tangled together flooded the battlefield.
hunks.sol: Sword clashed against sword. Ragged breathing mingled with hoarse cries. The killing intent and stench of blood from hundreds of people locked in battle flooded the air.

hunks.baseline: Amid the dawn mist blackened by poison smoke, those who had come to kill raised their weapons and charged at one another.
hunks.sol: Amid the dawn mist, blackened by poison smoke, those intent on killing raised their weapons and charged at one another.

hunks.baseline: A scream burst from the mouth of a young man.
hunks.sol: A young man screamed.

hunks.baseline: Born into a collateral branch of the great Sichuan Tang Clan, he had reached the First Rate realm without much difficulty. His considerable martial talent and composure beyond his years had made him the focus of everyone’s expectations.
hunks.sol: Born into a collateral branch of the great Sichuan Tang Clan, he had reached the First Rate realm without much difficulty. His considerable martial talent and composure beyond his years had earned him high expectations from everyone around him.

hunks.baseline: But now, the young man’s bright future lost its light alongside the black Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: But now, the young man’s bright future was extinguished by a flash of black Sword Energy.

hunks.sol: The Sword Energy carved diagonally through his upper body.
That was the end.

hunks.sol: The black-clad man stared at the young man’s collapsing body, his face pale as blood and entrails spilled out.

hunks.baseline: *The kid’s vicious.*
hunks.sol: *The kid was vicious.*

hunks.sol: The ox-hair needle that had somehow burrowed beneath the black-clad man’s collarbone was proof.

hunks.sol: *So this is the Sichuan Tang Clan.*

hunks.baseline: His vision blurred for an instant. The poisonous energy that had begun around his clavicle was rapidly spreading throughout his body.

hunks.sol: At this rate, even his Peak-level internal energy could do no more than buy him time.

hunks.baseline: No—instead, he smiled.
hunks.sol: No—he smiled.

hunks.baseline: The words came out muffled between his clenched teeth.
hunks.sol: The muffled words slipped between his clenched teeth.

hunks.sol: When he opened his mouth for the first time, a small bead lay inside.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, an eerie light flowed from the bead, running down the black-clad man’s throat like a river.
hunks.sol: An eerie light flowed from the bead and streamed down his throat like a river.

hunks.baseline: The change was instantaneous. His blurred vision cleared, and the body that had been losing its strength regained its power and vitality.
hunks.sol: The change was instantaneous. His blurred vision cleared, and strength and vitality returned to his weakening body.

hunks.baseline: After every trace of poison had been removed from his body, the black-clad man shuddered.
hunks.sol: As every trace of poison vanished from his body, the black-clad man shuddered.

hunks.baseline: The Lord of Heaven, the most dignified and greatest of all.
hunks.sol: The Lord of Heaven, nobler and greater than any other.

hunks.baseline: The life force granted by his god filled his entire body.
hunks.sol: The life force bestowed upon him by his god filled his entire body.

hunks.baseline: The black-clad man cried out in ecstasy and turned his head to search for another victim.
hunks.sol: With a cry of ecstasy, the black-clad man turned in search of another victim.

hunks.baseline: A dagger flying from somewhere buried itself in the black-clad man’s forehead.
hunks.sol: A throwing blade flew from somewhere and buried itself between his eyebrows.

hunks.baseline: The internal energy imbued in the dagger bored through flesh and bone, turning the black-clad man’s brain into mush. He died instantly.
hunks.sol: The internal energy carried by the blade tore through flesh and bone, reducing his brain to pulp. He died instantly.

hunks.baseline: The bead that rolled from the dead man’s mouth was drawn into someone’s hand.
hunks.sol: The bead rolled from the dead man’s mouth, then flew into someone’s hand.

hunks.baseline: An old man gazed at the bead with wizened gray eyes and muttered,
hunks.sol: An old man studied it with wizened gray eyes and muttered, “These bastards… They’re carrying artifacts.”

hunks.baseline: “These bastards… They’re carrying artifacts.”

hunks.sol: An ordinary martial artist would have assumed the bead was a poison-warding pearl.

hunks.baseline: But the old man, Tang Jinhu, was a direct descendant of the Sichuan Tang Clan and a veteran of the Great Faction War. He instinctively realized that this bead was something different from a poison-warding pearl.
hunks.sol: But the old man, Tang Jinhu, was a direct descendant of the Sichuan Tang Clan and a veteran of the Great Faction War. Instinct told him that this bead was something else.

hunks.sol: The next instant, dazzling white flashes filled the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: Blades, bone and flesh, and even the lives of his enemies.

hunks.sol: Tang Jinhu felled more than ten black-clad men with a single move, then released an azure dragon’s roar.

hunks.sol: “Would you look at these fucking bastards! How dare they invade our family? Do you not see the Heaven-Poison Wanderer before you?”

hunks.sol: Tang Jinhu was a Supreme Peak master who had retired more than a decade ago, as well as the head of the Council of Elders.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, brat! Do you have time to look away?”
hunks.sol: “Brat! Is this the time to be looking away?”

hunks.sol: “The great Lord of Heaven is with us! Kill them all!”

hunks.sol: A dozen Elders, including Tang Jinhu, and dozens of Peak masters whom the Tang Clan had painstakingly trained fought desperately.

hunks.sol: “I always thought the Sichuan Tang Clan was fairly practical for an orthodox faction. Looking at you, I suppose that isn’t entirely true. Not if you still indulge in such foolish fantasies.”

hunks.sol: “Youngster, you still don’t understand, do you? Then this old man will tell you himself.”

hunks.sol: First Fiend cackled.
